enemyWalkRepair14.cause: Enemy spear copied allied jog settings: stance .46 gives .08 both-feet flight and lift .105. Sin lift has nonzero derivative at contact boundaries; phase advances from real displacement and changes cadence as ingress queues. Lower SW source coverage has no missing opaque pixels.
enemyWalkRepair14.change: Enemy-only grounded .64 contact, .60 stride, .055 clearance, C1 continuous relative travel and zero vertical/angular lift derivative at contact boundaries. Original PNG, joint pivots, UV polygons and friendly settings preserved.
enemyWalkRepair14.validation: Analytical trajectory and metadata checks; HQ engine only.

userObservedCorrection.reason: Previous .60 stride/.64 contact enlarged fore-aft sweep to .384 body heights, 67% beyond the original .230; SW neutral feet also retained .254H fore-aft and .208H lateral separation.
userObservedCorrection.neutralLaneBasis: Original source hip lateral separation, no arbitrary fixed width.
userObservedCorrection.state: Superseded by sharedProfileCorrection14; neutral contact lanes retained, previous short-step trajectory rejected by user feedback.

sharedProfileCorrection14.evidence: tests/profiles/painted-click-03/actual-1791940167/click03-report.json: allied 24.13px/cycle versus prior enemy17.37px/cycle; enemy cadence39% higher per displacement and peak foot lift one third.
sharedProfileCorrection14.change: Enemy spear inherits exact actual allied stride/contact/lift/rotation/lean by direction; corrected neutral contact lanes and smooth contact-boundary interpolation retained.
sharedProfileCorrection14.verification: Metadata preservation and cadence checks only; HQ actual rendered acceptance required.

enemySpecialistWalkRepair09.cause: UV source hips were centered on the torso, but neutral soles were compressed around the leading boot anchor far to one side; the resulting IK overlapped and folded the two legs. Fixed draw order also obscured the rear leg during alternating steps.
enemySpecialistWalkRepair09.change: Center source anchor on pelvis, remove the static forward leg stagger by projecting original hip separation onto ground lateral, use opposing half-cycle contacts and current sole depth order, and preserve the same grounded idle registration.
enemySpecialistWalkRepair09.verification: Implementation only; no engine or tests run. Player review pending.

sourceRestSoleRepair.cause: Requested neutral soles differed from the registered source Foot.end. This forced both IK legs away from their own shoes even before stride; samurai and several side views had a large one-sided translation.
sourceRestSoleRepair.change: Rest soles use the exact same source shoe endpoints as the connected ankle/foot UV parts. No compressed lateral lane or translated replacement stance; original anchors, pelvis, UVs, bones and gait timing retained.
sourceRestSoleRepair.runtimeValidation: Not run. Source and original artwork inspection only; player gameplay validation remains pending.
sourceRestSoleRepair.remainingLimit: Walking remains a source-specific UV limb rig, not a newly authored full-body gait atlas. Existing source occlusion and missing enemy directions remain.

locomotionRepair02.implementation: native/painted_actor_renderer.gd; common two-leg projected contact solver
locomotionRepair02.groundBasis: Unproject actual screen displacement by 2:1 source camera, then use the same projected forward for cycle distance and foot sweep. Body/weapon facing remains separately owned.
locomotionRepair02.support: Ankles walk under their own source hips with original per-leg ground depth. Cycle length is bounded by original thigh/shin reach plus bounded support pelvis correction, not gameplay speed changes.
locomotionRepair02.contacts: 0.62 cycle stance and half-cycle alternation; Hermite swing matches planted derivative, squared-sine toe clearance and rotation have zero endpoint derivative.
locomotionRepair02.transitions: Simulation-clock blend, retained distance phase, planted points stored in canonical position plus body-height-relative offset; source rest recovered after stopping.
locomotionRepair02.upperBody: Anatomical-pelvis counterrotation of coherent shoulders/held-arms/weapon, no generic free-arm mask and no whole-sprite bob.
locomotionRepair02.validation: Source and analytical inspection only; no engine, preflight, game test or profiling run. Actual rendered gait is pending user play verification.
locomotionRepair02.remainingLimits: Source-specific UV limb motion and a coherent upper-body island are retained. This is not a new authored full-body gait. Reach-limited source views still have different cycle lengths; bounded contact release handles unreachable contacts on a view/pivot. Actual attack poses are not blended; distance phase is retained through them.
